summary: Reviewed src/ai, src/verify, src/notes against injection, child env/argv/cwd, key handling, output validation and limits. Ran the unit suite (87 pass) and a probe against the fake claude binary; no blocking issues found.

criteria.description: Untrusted note and title text cannot break out of the data block or act as instructions
CLI child: no shell, scrubbed env without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (even if listed in envPass), fixed argv with tools disabled, user data on stdin, fresh empty cwd removed afterwards
Model output is untrusted and re-validated against a strict schema with caps
Resource limits: stdout cap, timeouts with process-group kill, concurrency semaphore, budget flag, bounded retries; notes and verifier inputs bounded with no regex blowup

findings.title: Anthropic response body is fully buffered before the size check
findings.detail: src/ai/anthropic.js calls res.text() then compares length to maxResponseBytes, so the cap does not bound memory. The upstream is the configured trusted API URL, so impact is low. Not reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Stream the body with a byte cap, or check content-length first.

findings.title: Anthropic provider has no cost ceiling and reports costUsd 0
findings.detail: Spend is bounded only by max_tokens 4096, maxAttempts 3 and input size limits. The CLI path has --max-budget-usd. Not reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Compute cost from token usage, or enforce a per-day cap in the API layer.

findings.title: Operator config values reach argv and the outbound URL unchecked
findings.detail: GW_CLI_MODEL is passed to argv and could begin with a dash. GW_ANTHROPIC_URL receives the API key and is not required to be https. Both are operator-controlled only, not user-reachable.
findings.recommendation: Validate the model name pattern and require https for non-localhost URLs.

findings.title: Notes parser total input size is bounded only by line count
findings.detail: Bounds are 2000 lines of 2000 characters each. Whole-body size must be capped by the HTTP layer, which is not part of this gate. Parsing a worst-case 2000-line input took about 57 ms in the probe.
findings.recommendation: Confirm a request body limit when the API gate is reviewed.
